rows.grounds: huṃkāreṇa = with-huṃ-syllable; instrumental singular of huṃkāra (huṃ-syllable)
dvitīyāntu = second; sandhi for dvitīyām (f.acc.sg, agreeing with vīthikām) + tu (indecl., particle)
vīthikām = enclosure; accusative singular, object of pariveṣṭayet (avaraṇa/enclosure in Śrīvidyā context)
pariveṣṭayet = one-should-surround; optative prescribing ritual action
